news.title: Colten Ellis makes 23 saves to lead the Sabres past the Sharks 2-0
news.ruTitle: Колтен Эллис сделал 23 сейва и вывел «Сэйбрз» за победу над «Шаркс» со счетом 2–0.
news.description: — Colten Ellis made 23 saves in his first appearance in more than two weeks to lead the Buffalo Sabres to a 2-0 victory over the San Jose Sharks on Tuesday night.

news.title: Hronek’s OT power-play goal caps the Canucks’ 6-5 comeback win over the Ducks
news.ruTitle: Гол Хронека в большинстве в овертайме увенчал камбэк-победу "Кэнакс" над "Дакс" со счетом 6:5.
news.description: — Filip Hronek scored a power-play goal with 11 seconds to go in overtime to cap a run of four consecutive goals by the Vancouver Canucks, who snapped a 10-game losing streak with a 6-5 comeback win over the Anaheim Ducks on Tuesday night.

news.title: Islanders' Matthew Schaefer first on record to skate all 5 minutes of overtime
news.ruTitle: Игрок «Айлендерс» Мэтью Шефер первым в истории откатал все 5 минут овертайма
news.description: Islanders star defenseman Matthew Schaefer on Tuesday night became the first skater on record to skate all five minutes of an overtime period.

news.title: Raphael Lavoie scores his 1st NHL goal as the Golden Knights beat the Senators 4-1
news.ruTitle: Рафаэль Лавуа забивает свой первый гол в НХЛ, когда «Голден Найтс» обыграли «Сенаторз» со счетом 4–1.
news.description: — Raphael Lavoie scored his first career goal, a tap-in eight minutes into the third period to put Vegas ahead for good in its 4-1 victory over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night, ending the Golden Knights' three-game losing streak.

news.title: Kaprizov scores his NHL-leading 14th goal as the Wild beat the Mammoth 3-1
news.ruTitle: Капризов забивает свой лучший в НХЛ 14-й гол, когда «Уайлд» обыграли «Мамонта» со счетом 3–1.
news.description: — Kirill Kaprizov scored his NHL-leading 14th goal of the season and added an assist, Jesper Wallstedt stopped 26 of the 27 shots he faced, and the Minnesota Wild beat the Utah Mammoth 3-1 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Carter Verhaeghe scores 2 goals and Panthers extend Jets' slide to 6 games with 5-1 win
news.ruTitle: Картер Верхаге забил 2 гола, а «Пантеры» увеличили отрыв «Джетс» до 6 игр с победой со счетом 5–1.
news.description: — Carter Verhaeghe scored twice, Matthew Tkachuk had four assists and the Florida Panthers extended the Winnipeg Jets' slide to six games with a 5-1 victory on Tuesday night.

news.title: Palmieri, Horvat score in shootout, Varlamov gets 1st win since 2024 as Islanders beat Predators 4-3
news.ruTitle: Палмьери и Хорват забивают в серии пенальти, Варламов одерживает первую победу с 2024 года: «Айлендерс» обыграли «Предаторз» со счетом 4–3
news.description: — Kyle Palmieri and Bo Horvat scored in a shootout to lead the New York Islanders to a 4-3 victory over the Nashville Predators on Tuesday night.

news.title: Aho's late goal helps Kochetkov improve to 8-0-0 as Hurricanes beat Bruins 2-1
news.ruTitle: Поздний гол Ахо помог Кочеткову улучшить счет до 8-0-0, когда "Харрикейнз" обыграли "Брюинз" 2-1.
news.description: — Sebastian Aho’s third-period goal gave the Carolina Hurricanes a 2-1 win over the Boston Bruins in a matchup of early leaders in the Eastern Conference on Tuesday night.

news.title: Jacob Fowler makes 46 saves for 2nd shutout of season as Canadiens beat Blues 2-0
news.ruTitle: Джейкоб Фаулер сделал 46 сейвов во втором матче сезона, когда "Канадиенс" обыграли "Блюз" со счетом 2:0.
news.description: — Jacob Fowler made a career-high 46 saves for his second shutout of the season, and Zachary Bolduc and Florian Xhekaj scored as the Montreal Canadiens defeated the St. Louis Blues 2-0 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Connor Hellebuyck stops 17 shots in 'fun' debut as Devils stop Stars
news.ruTitle: Коннор Хеллебак отразил 17 бросков в «веселом» дебюте, когда «Дьяволы» остановили «Старз»
news.description: Connor Hellebuyck stopped 16 of 17 shots in his New Jersey debut, helping the Devils beat the Dallas Stars 5-1.

news.title: Connor Hellebuyck earns win in his Devils debut as New Jersey beats Dallas 5-1
news.ruTitle: Коннор Хеллебак одержал победу в своем дебютном матче за «Девилз»: «Нью-Джерси» обыграл «Даллас» со счетом 5–1.
news.description: — Connor Hellebuyck stopped 16 of the 17 shots he faced to win his New Jersey debut, Nico Hischier scored two goals, and the Devils beat the Dallas Stars 5-1 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Wyatt Kaiser scores as the Chicago Blackhawks stop a 3-game slide, topping the Los Angeles Kings 2-1
news.ruTitle: Уятт Кайзер забивает, когда «Чикаго Блэкхокс» останавливают отставание в трех матчах, обыгрывая «Лос-Анджелес Кингз» со счетом 2–1.
news.description: — Wyatt Kaiser snapped a third-period tie, Spencer Knight made 25 saves and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the Los Angeles Kings 2-1 on Tuesday night.
